hero.title: Hi, I'm Yoshan!
hero.description: I'm a software engineer who enjoys building interactive and technically challenging software, with experience spanning simulation, graphics, game development, data visualisation, and machine learning.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: I'm a software engineer with a background in Computer Science and a particular interest in solving problems that sit at the intersection of software engineering and visual computing. I've worked with C++, C#, Java, Python, and TypeScript across projects involving real-time simulation, 3D graphics, game development, ray tracing, machine learning, and data visualisation. I enjoy learning new technologies, experimenting with ideas, and working through difficult problems until I find a solution. I also value collaborative development and enjoy discussing different approaches to a problem before turning an idea into working software.

experience.title: Experience
experience.description: My experience spans professional software development, teaching, and academic research, with a consistent focus on building software and exploring technically challenging problems.

experience: Develop virtual experiences and interactive applications using Unity.
Build automation tools in Python to support 3D animation workflows.
Create and integrate 3D animations and assets using Blender.
Work as part of a team to design, develop, test, and refine software solutions.
Supported practical teaching for video game programming and mobile development modules.
Explained programming and software development concepts to students with different levels of experience.
Helped students debug code and solve coursework problems through one-to-one guidance.
Developed the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and adapt explanations to different audiences.
Studied a broad range of computer science topics including software engineering, graphics, artificial intelligence, data visualisation, and game development.
Conducted research into photon mapping and global illumination as part of a project exploring physically based rendering techniques.
Developed an agent-based simulation for generating social networks within a simulated city environment.
Designed and implemented data visualisations both individually and as part of a team.
Applied machine learning techniques to point-cloud data captured using an Xbox Kinect to investigate object recognition.
